wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxDocSearch
CogniDoxApproveDoc
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will mark the specified version of the document as approved. Note: this only provides approval for a single user. Other user's approvals may be required in order to fully move the document into the approved state.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist. * The specified version number does not exist. * The user does not have the permission to approve documents. * The user has limited access to the document. * Additional verification is required in order to make the approval. * Changes could not be actioned. * The user has not been requested to approve the version of the document.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document. @param IssueNumber, the version number of the document. @param ApprovalComment, descriptive text for the approval. @return Approved, a value of '1' indicates success. If missing then there was an error.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCreateDoc
CogniDoxCategorySearch
CogniDoxCreateVersion
CogniDoxPublishDoc
CogniDoxUnpublishDoc
CogniDoxDeleteDoc
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will attempt to delete a document.
The method will fail if:
* The category does not exist. * A document version exists and the user is not the document creator and the user does not have permission to delete the document. * The user cannot alter the document properties. * The document is frozen. * The document is locked by another user. * No deletion comment is provided. * The document does not exist.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document to delete. @param DeleteComment, a description as to why the document is being deleted. @return Deleted, with a value of '1' if the document was deleted.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxDocInfo
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will retrieve detailed information for a specific document. This information includes the title, author latest version, next draft, next issue, the security key, a set of versions, the editing and approved versions, the file name, whether the document is read-only, it's path within the repository and any meta-data associated with it.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist. * The user has been blocked access to the document.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document to look up. @return A InfoResult containing part number, title, published, URL, latest version, latest approved version, author, read-only state, CogniDoxKey, next draft, next issue, set of category path values, set of meta-data with key/value pairs and a set of VersionItem with revision, approved, file, MD5 hash, comment, issue time, issuer and public comment details. Also included are a set of version tag values, a set of owners, whether obsolete, a set of licenses, a set of workspaces and whether the document is checked out and by whom.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxMetaVal
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will update a piece of meta-data associated with the specified document.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist. * The document has been locked and so cannot be changed. * The user does not have permission to modify meta-data. * The user does not have permission to change a document's properties. * The user is blocked from accessing the document. * The named meta-data does not exist. * The user does not have permission to modify the meta-data field.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document. @param MetaName, the name of the meta-data item. @param MetaVal, a collection of one or more meta-data values. @return MetaData, a collection of MetaDataItem elements containing the name and value of each meta-data item associated with the document.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxDocSecurity
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will retrieve the user's permissions for the specified document. For example whether the document is read-only or not.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist or no part number was supplied.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document. @return SecurityResult containing a set of rights, with their name and whether the right is granted or not for the user.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCheckout
CogniDoxCreateVersionMTOM
CogniDoxCategoryList
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return a list of sub-categories and documents in the specified category.
The method will fail if:
* The category does not exist.
The method will return empty lists for unregistered or limited access users.
@param CategoryId, containing the identity of the category to retrieve information for. @return Zero or more Documents and Categories containing the details of each child. If there are any documents in the category then each Item will contain the document's part number, title and URL values. If there are any sub-categories, then for each one, there will be an Item containing the category identity, name, whether it has children and sub categories.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCheckin
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will remove a check-out lock on a document.
This method will fail if:
* The document does not exist. * The user does not have permission to create a lock. * The user does not have permission to delete a lock. * The user does not have permission to alter the document's properties.
The document must either be checked-out by the user, or checked-out by another user and the user calling the method must have rights to check-in other user's check-outs.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document to check-in. @param ForceCheckin, optional boolean to indicate whether to remove another user's check-out. @return Unlocked, which is '1' if the document is no longer locked.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCategoryInfo
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will retrieve the permissions, workspace and related forms for a specific category in Cognidox.
The method will fail if:
* The category does not exist. * The user is not registered with the system. * The user does not have permission to access the category.
@param CategoryId, the integer ID of the category to retrieve the permission details of. @return CategoryName, CategorySubtitle, CanCreateDocuments, CanCreateCategories, CanDelete, CanRename provide the name and tile of the category along with a set of boolean flags indicating whether a user can enumerate, modify or delete the category. If the category is part of a workspace then WorkspaceId and WorkspacePath contain the details. Should the category also include one or more forms a collection of CategoryForm entries will carry the FormId, CategoryFormId, FormName, CategoryFormTitle, CategoryFormDocType and Active values.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCategoryCreate
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will attempt to create a new category in Cognidox with a given name. The ID for the parent category must be given along with the name for the new category.
This method will fail if:
* A category of the same name already exists in the parent category. * The parent category does not exist. * The user does not have permission to access the parent category. * The user does not have permission to create a category.
@param ParentCategoryId, integer ID of the parent category. Zero if creating a top level category. @param CategoryName, the name of the new category to create. If no value supplied then the 'New category' name is used. @return CategoryID and CategoryName containing the ID and name of the newly created category.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCategoryRename
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will change the name of the specified category.
The method will fail if:
* The category does not exist. * No new name is provided. * A category already exists with the supplied name. * The user is not registered with the system. * The user does not have permission to change categories. * The user does not have permission to the category and/or it's parents. * The user does not have permission to update the name.
@param CategoryId, the identity of the category to update. @param CategoryName, the new name value for the category. @return CategoryName, containig the value assigned to the category. This may be the same value before the change.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCategoryDelete
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will attempt to delete a category from Cognidox.
The method will fail if:
* The category does not exist. * The user does not have permission to delete categories. * The user does not have permission to access the category. * The category contains documents, or has sub-categories that contain documents.
@param CategoryId, the integer ID of the category to delete.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCategoryNewDocumentInfo
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method returns the suggested author, document types and any recommended titles that can be used when creating a document in a category.
The method will fail if:
* The category does not exist. * The user is not registered with the system. * The user does not have permission to create a document in the category.
@param CategoryId, the integer ID of the category the document is being created in. @param FilenameExtension, an optional filename extension for the document being created. The document type list will be filtered to only show those types which will accept the filename extension. @param EmailAddress, an optional email address to pass in that can be used to look up the suggested author of the document. @return SuggestedTitle, the suggested title of the document. SuggestedAuthor, the suggested name as the author of the document. DocumentTypes, the list of valid document types. Titles, a list of recommended titles and their document type.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxDocActions
CogniDoxRenameDoc
CogniDoxDocTemplates
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return the set of document templates for the specified part number.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist. * The user does not have permission to access the document. * The user is not registered with the system.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document. @return Templates, a set of TemplateDocument elements containing the part number, title and filename of each template.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxSystemInfo
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return information about the running Cognidox server.
@return ProductName and ProductVersion which are the locally configured Cognidox name and the running Cognidox version. SOAPVersion contains the version of the SOAP API. WorkflowOptions contains additional information about the document workflow, namely whether comments are required when submitting drafts or issues. Whether version information is also required during submissions. The workflow details also contain whether document check-out is required. Finally whether use of the Add-in is blocked and the current UTC time of the server.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCategorySet
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will set the categories that a document is part of.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist. * One or more of the set of categories does not exist. * No categories were specified. * The document cannot be placed into one or more of the categories. * The user does not have permission to set categories. * The user does not have permission to change the properties of the document. * The category depth is less than that the allowed by the system configuration value.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document to update. @param CopyDocument, '1' to copy the document to each category. @param Categories, a collection containing the path and ID of each category.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCategoryTitles
CogniDoxAddDocLicense
CogniDoxRemoveDocLicense
CogniDoxListLicenses
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return information about all the licenses in Cognidox, including those marked as hidden.
The method will fail if:
* The user does not have permission to view licenses.
@return Licenses, a collection of license values.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCreateLicense
CogniDoxDeleteLicense
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will remove a license from Cognidox.
The method will fail if:
* A license with the specified name does not exist. * The user does not have permission to delete licenses. * No license name value was provided.
@param License, the name of the license to remove. @return Deleted, with a value of '1' if the license was removed.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxDocAgreements
CogniDoxDocLockInfo
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return information about any locks on a document.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist.
If either of the following occurs, then no information is returned.
* The repository does not allow unregistered user access. * The user has been blocked from accessing the document.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document to get the information for. @return Locked, which is true if the document is currently locked. LockType, which is the lock type - either lock or freeze. LockUser, which is the login of the user who created the lock. LockComment, which is the comment associated with the lock. LockDate, which is the date the lock was created. Unlockable, whether the calling user can remove the lock. Unlockable and LockRequired indicate whether a lock can be acquired and whether one is required to add a new version.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxObsoleteDoc
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will mark a document as obsolete if the user has sufficient rights and the document is not already obsolete. Note: the operation can be undone with the CogniDoxUnobsoleteDoc operation.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist. * The user does not have permission to change status. * The user does not have permission to alter the properties of the document. * The document has already been set to be obsolete.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document to obsolete. @param ObsoleteComment, an optional comment to use when obsoleting the document. @return Obsoleted, '1' if the document was set as obsolete, otherwise '0'.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxUnobsoleteDoc
CogniDoxListFilenameExtensions
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return a list of file types that Cognidox will accept.
If given a document type value, it will list the file types that are valid for that document type.
The method will fail if:
* The user is not registered with the system.
@param DocType, an optional document type to check for. @return FilenameExtensions containing a set of FilenameExtension elements, each with a valid extension value.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxListDocumentReviewers
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return a list of the valid review users for a document with a given version in Cognidox.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist. * The user does not have permission to access the document.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document to retrieve information for. @param IssueNumber, the version number of the document. @return AvailableReviewers, a collection of Reviewer elements containing the name and login of all the reviewers with permission to carry out a review. Together with MandatoryReviews, a collection of Review elements containing the name and login of each reviewer that must review the document. Additional information is provided of the review groups and the users that are in them.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCancelReview
CogniDoxCreateReview
CogniDoxRejectDoc
CogniDoxListWorkspaces
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will retrieve a list of all of the private workspaces that the user can access.
The method will fail if:
* The user is not registered with the system.
@return Workspaces, a collection of Workspace elements containing the id and category path of each workspace.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxAddMeetingNoteMTOM
CogniDoxListReviewRequests
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will retrieve a list of all of the open review requests for a user. Only documents that the user has not been blocked from accessing are included.
The method will fail if:
* The user is not registered on the system.
@return ReviewRequests, a collection of Task elements containing the part number, issue, title, action URL, comment, who requested the review, when it was created and any due date. Note: the task type is always 'review'.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxListApprovalRequests
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will retrieve a list of all of the open approval requests for a user.
The method will fail if:
* The user is not registered with the system.
An approval request is excluded if it has already been answered or if the user is blocked from accessing the document.
@return ApprovalRequests, a collection Task elements containing the part number, issue number, title, action URL, approval comment, the details of whom made the review request, when the request was created and any due date.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxListPolicyTasks
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will retireve a list of all of the user's outstanding view policy tasks. Only documents that the user has not been blocked from accessing are included.
The method will fail if:
* The user is not registered with the system.
@return ViewPolicyTasks, a collection of Task elements containing the part number, title, action URL, comment and task type for each view policy that needs to be actioned.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxListDocumentTypes
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return a list of the document types that are configured and can be used in part numbers.
If a filename extension is provided, only the document types that will accept the extension will be returned.
The method will fail if:
* The user is not registered with the system.
@param FilenameExtension, an optional filename extension to filter the types by. @param ShowLegacyTypes, an optional boolean to indicate whether legacy types should be included or not. @return DocumentTypes, a set of Items containing the title and code of valid types.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxDocFileInfo
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method returns the filenames for the master and PDF (if it exists) for a specified part number.
The method will fail if:
* A document does not exist with the specified part number. * The user is blocked from accessing the document.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document. @return ApprovedVersion and LatestVersion items containing the version, Master and PDF files, together with whether the user has permission to access them.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxAddPDFVersion
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
Add a Portable Document Format (PDF) variant of the specified versioned document. This can be used to overwrite the automatically generated one or to add one when Cognidox is unable to convert the document to PDF format.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist. * The user does not have permission to upload a PDF. * The user has limited access to the document. * The specified issue does not exist. * The issue is locked against changes. * No PDF data was supplied. * The document's type does not support the addition of PDFs. * The document is currently checked-out and cannot be modified. * The document is frozen and cannot be modified. * The latest PDF associated with the document has shared notes. * The master file is already a PDF. * There is a digital signature on the existing PDF and so cannot be overriden. * The PDF is less than 512 bytes in size. * The bytes do not have a signature that identifies it as a PDF file. * The bytes of the PDF cannot be written.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document. @param IssueNumber, the version number of the document. @param PDFFile, the base64 encoded data of the PDF file to add. @return PDFAdded, a value of '1' indicates success. If missing then there was an error.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxBriefcaseList
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return a list of documents in the specified compartment. The list also contains details of any specified document part number. If no compartment name is specified then all documents in all compartments are returned.
The returned collection is empty if there are no documents that match the supplied criteria.
The method will fail if:
* The user is not registered with the system.
@param Compartment, an optional name of the compartment to examine. @param PartNumber, an optional document identity. @return A collection of Items, containing the part number, title, URL, filename, version, modified, MD5 hash, whether it appears in the briefcase, whether the document is locked, whether it is checked-out and by whom. There is also information about the original MD5 hash, the approved version and filename. Finally a collection of the names of which compartments that the document is located in.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxBriefcaseAddDocument
CogniDoxBriefcaseRemoveDocument
CogniDoxDocRelationships
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will retrieve all the relationships, the type and second party document, that the specified document is in.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist.
If either of the following occurs, then no information is returned.
* The repository does not allow unregistered user access. * The user blocked from accessing the document. * The user does not have permission to view one or both documents in the relationship.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document to retrieve the information for. @return Relationships, a collection of Relationship elements with details about the source document, it's part number, title and version. Together with the destination document and it's part number, title and version. Finally the Relationship element contains the type of the relationship.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxBriefcaseCompartmentsList
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will list the compartments within the briefcase.
The method will fail if:
* The user is not registered with the system.
@return A collection of Item elements, containing the id, name and creator of each compartment. The item also indicates whether the compartment is read-only or not.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxListVdataMaps
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will retrieve a list of virtual data filename extension mappings.
The method will fail if:
* The user is not registered with the system.
@return VdataMaps, a collection of Item elements with the source extension and a collection of destination extensions for each map.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxBriefcaseAddCompartment
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will add a new compartment to the briefcase.
The method will fail if:
* No name value was provided. * The user is not registered with the system.
@param Name, the name of the new compartment. @return Compartment, containing the name and id of the new compartment. If missing then there was an error.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxBriefcaseRenameCompartment
CogniDoxBriefcaseRemoveCompartment
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will remove the named compartment from the briefcase.
The method will fail if:
* The user is not registered with the system. * The named compartment does not exist. * The compartment was not created by the user.
@param Compartment, the name of the compartment to remove. @return Removed, a value of '1' indicates success. If missing then there was an error.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxSearchHelp
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return information about how to use the search system.
@return SearchHelp, details on how to perform a search in HTML format.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxListSavedSearches
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will retrieve a list of all of the user's saved searches.
The method will fail if:
* The user is not registered with the system.
@return SavedSearches, a collection of SavedSearch elements containing the id, title and creator of the search.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxDocSavedSearch
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will perform a saved search and return the matching documents.
The method will fail if:
* The user is not registered with the system. * The user is unregistered and permission has not been granted.
@param SavedSearchId, the identity of the search to perform. @return Results, a collection of Result elements containing the part number, title, whether published, URL, meta-data, filename of the matched documents.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCreateFormDoc
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will create a document from a form associated with the category.
The method will fail if:
* The form does not exist. * No identity was provided for the form. * No title was specified for the document. * The user does not have permission to create part numbers. * The user does not have permission to use forms. * The user does not have permission to create documents from a form.
@param Title, the title of the document. @param CategoryFormID, the identity of the form. @return PartNumber, the part number assigned to the new document.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxDocReviewStatus
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will retrieve all of the review requests and related answers on the specified document.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist. * The user does not have permission to view sign off history. * The user is blocked from accessing the document. * The user does not have permission to view the review history of the document.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document to retrieve information for. @return ReviewItems, a collection of ReviewItem elements containing the part number, issue number, answer type, request comment and time, any due date, who made the request. The information also includes the answers to the review, what was said, when and by whom. Each response may include a licensee contact and any attachments.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxCustomReportList
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will list all of the custom report documents.
The method will fail if:
* The report does not exist. * The user is not registered on the system. * The report is not visible to the user.
@param ReportId, the identity of the report to locate. @return Documents, a collection of Items containing the part number, title, URL, filename, version, modified state and MD5 hash value. If the document is read-only then information about the user that has checked out the document is included. Additionally there is information about the approved version and its filename.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxSignDoc
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will request that a document is signed.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist. * The user does not have permission to sign documents. * The user does not have permission to view the document. * The user does not have permission to view the master document. * The user does not have a signing key. * The supplied pass phrase is not the correct one for the signing key. * The document has already been signed by the user. * The file associated with the document could not be found for signing. * The document has not yet been approved.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document. @param IssueNumber, the version of the document. @param PassPhrase, the phrase associated with the key that is to be used to sign the document. @return Signed, '1' if the document was successfully signed, otherwise '0'.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxListForms
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return information about all of the forms defined in Cognidox.
The method will fail if:
* The user does not have permission to use forms.
@return Forms, a collection of Form elements, containing the id, name and fields of each form. The Fields collection, within the form, contain the details of each field, it's id, label and type.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxDocFormData
CogniDoxDocFormSearch
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will retrieve a set of documents that match a set of search criteria.
The method will fail if:
* The user does not have permission to search forms.
@param A collection of SeachField elements containing the identities of the forms, fields and one or two search values. @return Documents, a collection of the part numbers of the documents that matched the search criteria.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxTasksListTypes
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return a list of task types that Cognidox has been configured with.
If a part number is specified, the only task types that are valid for that specific document will be returned.
The method will fail if:
* The user is not registered with the system.
@param PartNumber, an optional document identity to filter by. @param TaskTypeId, an optional identity of a task type to filter by. @return TaskTypes, a set of TaskType elements containing the identity name, description, creator, whether active, whether multiple instances can exist, any version restrictions, any approval restrictions, any publish restrictions. Each task type, includes the set of document types, title and code, associated with the task. If there are any managers assigned to the task, these are also present in the result. Finally each TaskType can include the set of task states, the state's id and name.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxTasksListDocumentTaskRequests
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return a list of the active task requests for a document.
The method will fail if:
* The document does not exist. * The user does not have permission to use tasks. * The user is blocked from accessing the document.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document. @return OpenTaskRequests, a set of TaskRequest items containing the task request identity, task type identity and name, the part number of the document, the task creator, date of creation of the task, any due date, comments and if locked, by whom.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxTasksCreateTaskRequest
CogniDoxTasksCancelTaskRequest
CogniDoxTasksAcceptTaskRequest
CogniDoxTasksCancelTask
CogniDoxTasksSetTaskState
CogniDoxTasksCreateTask
CogniDoxTasksListDocumentTasks
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return a list of the active tasks for a document.
The method will fail if:
* The user does not have permission to use tasks. * The user is not registered with the system. * The user is blocked from accessing the document.
@param PartNumber, the identity of the document. @return OpenTasks, a set of Task items containing the task identity, task type identity and name, the part number of the document, the task creator, date of creation of the task, any due date, any comment and any state details such as state identity and name.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxTasksListUserTasks
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return a list of the tasks assigned to the requesting user and a list of all of the open tasks the user has created.
The method will fail if:
* The user does not have permission to use tasks. * The user is not registered with the system.
@return OpenTasks, a collection of Task items the user must action. RequestedTasks, a collection of Task items the user has created. Each Task contains the identity, the type identity and name, part number of the document, any due date, any comment, who was assigned the task, the creator, date of creation and any state information.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxTasksListUserTaskRequests
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return a list of the open task requests for the requesting user and a list of all the open task requests that have been created by the user.
The method will fail if:
* The user does not have permission to use tasks. * The user is not registered with the system.
@return OpenTaskRequests, a collection of TaskRequest items the user can accept. RequestedTaskRequests, a collection of TaskRequest items the user has created. Each TaskRequest contains the request identity, task type identity and name, document part number, who created it and when. If there is a due date or comment these too will be present. If the task is locked, details of who has the lock is present as well.

wsdl:operation.name: CogniDoxTasksForwardTask
CogniDoxDocCustomReportSearch
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation:
This method will return the set of documents for a custom report.
The method will fail if:
* The user does not have permission to access the custom report. * The user is not registered with the system.
@param CustomReportId, the identity of the custom report. @return A collection of Result elements, each containing the part number, title, whether the document has been published, it's URL and filename.
